editorNote: A single disclosed event dominates today's watchlist: Alphabet's third-quarter report, where doubled Cloud revenue sat alongside soft Search growth and negative free cash flow. Other watchlist items yielded no fetched, dated material today.

stories.headline: Alphabet reports $127.6B revenue as Cloud doubles; shares fall more than 11% after hours
stories.summary: Revenue rose 25% to $127.6B and Google Cloud grew 103% to $30.7B, but Search grew 12% to $63.4B, below the roughly 15% analysts expected. Capex was $51.4B and free cash flow was negative $9.1B.
stories.whyItMatters: Per Fortune, shares fell more than 11% after hours, erasing over $280B of market value; Alphabet confirmed about $200B of 2026 capex and expects roughly $300B in 2027. EPS of $2.12 was hit by an $8.7B paper loss on equity investments.
